title: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad
subtitle: Śukla Yajurveda · Principal Upaniṣad
overview: A major Upaniṣad presented through dialogues and teachings on the Self, knowledge, reality, death and liberation. The chapter-by-chapter English reader is being prepared; only independently checked passages should be added as full readings.
